topic: Safe Use and Care of Household Materials
key_concepts: Household cleaning materials include soap, water, and bleach
Hazardous products must be stored out of children's reach
Read and follow label instructions before using chemicals
Unknown liquids should never be tasted
Wash hands after handling chemical products
Close chemical containers tightly after use
Leave the area or cover the nose when insecticide is sprayed indoors
Flammable materials can cause fire and must not be played with
Sharp tools like knives require adult supervision
Spraying pesticides without protective gear can cause illness
Chemical labels help users know contents and use them properly
